title: PGx phenotype match result
description: One normalised phenotype compared with one WP-11 phenotype condition. It records what was compared and what came of it, and deliberately nothing about what the answer should cause: additionalProperties is false, so an attention level, a coverage status, a dose, a recommendation, a risk score, a safety statement or a paragraph of report prose cannot be attached to it by anything downstream. Those belong to WP-13, WP-14 and WP-15. The three input statuses are first-class results rather than kinds of NO_MATCH, because 'this rule does not apply' and 'we could not tell whether it applies' are different answers and only the first is a statement about the input.

operator.description: The two WP-11 operators. There is no third, and in particular none that widens a declared set.

declared_phenotypes.description: Exactly what the condition listed. A reader can check the verdict against it without loading the rule.

condition_hash.description: The exact condition evaluated, so a stored decision can be checked against the rule that produced it rather than against a rule sharing its identity and carrying different content.
